title: Specific commodities to be packed and sold in recommended standard packages.

checks.requirement: Evaluate the package or inspection data against the legal requirement preserved in source_text.

source_text:
5. Specific commodities to be packed and sold in recommended standard packages. -
The commodities specified in the Second Schedule shall be packed for sale, distribution
or delivery in such standard quantities as are specified in that Schedule:
*Provided that if a commodity specified in the Second Schedule is packed in a size other
than that prescribed in that Schedule, a declaration that 'Not a standard pack size under
the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 or 'non standard size under




the Legal Metrology (packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011' shall be made prominently on
the label of such package.
* Provision will stand withdrawn wef 01.07.2012 vide GSR 748(E) dated 24.10.2011
